scenes.title: Sela Thorn at pier four
scenes.summary: The party looks for a boat and meets Sela Thorn, who reads the tides and will row them, but never at night, for two silver after Oren's persuasion. She says Saltmere Mine flooded the night the bell first rang, forty years ago, and offers a ride at first light tomorrow.

scenes.title: Hymn pages in the Saltmere Mine
scenes.summary: The tunnel floods thirty paces in with warm black water and floating hymn-book pages. A page carries the pencilled margin note "M. Brand", which Teo recognises as his sister Mira's handwriting. Dana and Priya speculate that harbor-master Maren leads the cult. Oren takes 2 damage from bad air (down to 11).

scenes.title: Midnight bell at the drowned chapel
scenes.place: Shore below the old chapel ruins, Gullwick bay
scenes.summary: At the shore, fishermen warn of the Kelp Mother. At midnight the bell rings twelve times under the water and the humming is louder than two nights ago. Pale shapes stand in rows on the chapel floor, then vanish, and the party flees.

scenes.title: Plan for the dive at the Tarred Gull
scenes.summary: The party plans to have Sela row them out at first light tomorrow and dive to the chapel at low tide, and Dana will buy rope and a second lantern. Innkeeper Bram feeds them and says he has known Maren for thirty years and that she lost a brother to the bay. The party takes a long rest.
